entries.title: Joshua 20:5
segments: Our lives are always uncertain, and are liable to be suddenly taken away, either by design or through our own carelessness or mistakes, or those of our fellow men.

entries.title: Joshua 20:6
segments:
Judgment; a fair trial and a righteous decision. 
 
As life may be destroyed through carelessness as well as by design, carelessness is a sin which should be most conscientiously avoided, and if it is not, should be visited with its appropriate punishment.

entries.title: Joshua 20:7
segments:
Mount Naphtali; the hilly region in the tribe of Naphtali, in the north part of the country. 
 
  Shechem; this was in the central part, and Hebron in the south part of the country.

entries.title: Joshua 20:8
segments: Bezer; a city in the south part of the country, east of the Jordan; Ramoth was in the central, and Golan in the north part of the country.

entries.title: Joshua 20:9
segments: No person accused of murder should be acquitted or condemned till after a full and fair trial; nor should he suffer death unless proved to be guilty.
